name: I Did It ALL for the COOKIE!
source:
You are hanging out at a festive Christmas party when your eyes discover the most perfect Christmas confectionery ever!  You must have it!... but someone already has it!  What will you be willing to do, to get your Christmas wish?

[From [url=https://rodenburg.itch.io/i-did-it-all-for-the-cookie]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你正在参加节日圣诞派对时，你的眼睛发现了有史以来最完美的圣诞糖果！你必须拥有它！…但已经有人拥有它了！为了实现你的圣诞愿望，你愿意做什么？

[来自[url=https://rodenburg.itch.io/i-did-it-all-for-the-cookie]Itch.io[/url]]
